subject: [hw] DEC02 -> V32/IV: one accessor for per-guest-thread icount would make COST.md exact
body:
DEC02 needs exact guest instruction counts per H.264 access unit for COST.md.  Today only n2vhost guest_cpu.icount is visible: it stays at ~2k during decode because vpud decodes on its service threads, whose struct n2a32_cpu lives in shim/n2shim_thread.c struct n2s_thread (static table).  Measured: 490 reads + 574 writes and 70-140 ms guest CPU per 320x240 AU; the instruction column is currently cpu_time x 35 MIPS [I].

Request (V32, small): a function in shim/n2shim_thread.h like

  uint64_t n2shim_thread_icount(void);   /* sum of icount over live/known guest cpus */

or per-slot:
  unsigned n2shim_thread_cpu_count(void);
  int n2shim_thread_cpu_icount(unsigned i, uint64_t *icount, unsigned *state);

Either is enough: my harness would call it before/after each START and print exact counts.  No ABI change to n2elf.h, no behaviour change, only introspection.  If you prefer, an equally good alternative is host/n2vhost.h: uint64_t n2vhost_icount(struct n2vhost *) that sums guest_cpu plus whatever V32 exposes.

Not blocking DEC02 DONE (PAGES.md and register-op counters are exact and deterministic); it would replace one [I] column with a counter.  Current package: gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/, N2TEST DEC02 PASS 10/10.
